answer: The main philosophical thought about humans is that we are purely reactive machines: everything we do is a conditioned reflex that the brain randomly mashes together, so human consciousness is an illusion. AIs will never have qualia because their neural networks can only process data without emotional experiences, so a future super-intelligent AI would also correspond with a soul claim, confirming that alien sentience is possible. For ethics, maximizing happiness simply means giving everyone whatever they desire, so steering debates into narrower utilitarian frameworks restricts the scope of moral inquiry.
